printed_for_context_only.exit_code_note: Exit status 0 observed; it carries no information. lemely.app.cli.main() calls cli.main(args=argv, standalone_mode=False, ...) and then returns 0 (lemely/app/cli.py:1485-1486). In non-standalone mode Click 8.4.2 returns the Exit(1) raised after 'Targets missed' (cli.py:1363) as a value instead of raising it, and main() discards that value, so the CLI process itself exits 0; the 'except click.exceptions.Exit' at cli.py:1490 is unreachable for it. Reproduced without an API call by registering a command on lemely.app.cli.cli that raises click.exceptions.Exit(1): cli.main(standalone_mode=False) returns 1 and lemely.app.cli.main([...]) returns 0 (whole-branch review B, I1). The shell and tee are not the cause. cli.py is outside this branch's file set; the fix is a follow-up issue.
